parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs indicated for leukemia. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter where mesh_heading contains 'leukemia' (case-insensitive) and max_phase_for_ind equals 4. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, EFO ID (efo_id) as indication_curie, indication label (mesh_heading) as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
